evidence.how: The receiver's 2xx. A firm's webhook confirmed to deduplicate on our lead id is set duplicates: idempotency-key, and is then resent after an unknown outcome

toConfirm: Duplicate handling: we send the lead id as the signed webhook-id header, the same on every retry, so a receiver can deduplicate on it; whether a given receiver does is its own choice, so this stays unknown per receiver (RFC-008 §4.3)
